title: Numbers and NaN

blocks.md:
## Not a Number is still a number kind

`Number("fox")` is `NaN`. `typeof NaN` is `"number"`. `NaN === NaN` is **false**. A desk that stores lamp current as a number must catch that — otherwise it files a broken reading as if it were zero.

Use `Number.isNaN(x)` when you mean “this failed to become a number.”

hintLadder.md: Number("fox") is NaN. Number.isNaN tells you that on purpose.
